patch_description: This edit improves the signal quality and win rate by implementing session-adaptive entry thresholds and tightening microstructure filters (OBI, VWAP deviation, spread, and funding). It also introduces a liquidity-based penalty directly into the entry threshold (inspired by the top-performing 92.88 score program) and refines the position sizing and max-bars logic to focus on high-confidence, high-persistence regimes.
